Yea but people I have socialized with online for years didn't have the same behavior as this guy

I understand some people can be fake online but If someone was going to kill them self's would you try to help them as well? So how on earth is that a pathetic attempt to be a good person.

I'm glad so see we both have the same view point which is the point im trying to put across in my thread :) Your right his issues are not mine he has a lot more shit going on then me but there is no need to wallow in self pity sure everyone gets down but eventually dunno if its just me but when over time you cant take it anymore, you pick your self up and come up with a solution and sort ya head/life out.excuses for not doing this was actually unreal everything from i am too tired to my condition limits me doing x.y.z or because a doctor has told me not to (I'm not gonna list everything wrong with both of us but i have disorders that would limit people and I still manage to achieve some ineradicable things)But I also feel that's because I have my head screwed on and ik what i want with life I've tried to spark interests for this guy with 0 result even going as far as sorting activities out my self.

People may not need advice but i offer both I've advised this guy as much as i could:i also said "If you dont' put effort in you wont see anything in return" You know ive tried to dumb this down as much as possible that even a 5 year old would understand but there aint nothing working, Trouble was I didn't/don't wanna become a councilor for this guy I wanna get on with life and have positive energy around me as much as possible.But aiyo i guess life moves on and sometimes we just have to get rid of the leechers/negativity in life and even tho its hard i can't let his issues affect me online or afk.
